players.bio: Antonee Burke-Gilroy (born 3 October 1997) is an English footballer who plays for Brisbane Roar.
Austin Ludwik (born 11 February 1997) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for Brisbane Roar.

Benjamin Halloran (born 14 June 1992) is an Australian soccer player who plays as a winger for Brisbane Roar in the A-League, Australia's top division for association football. He has previously represented Australia, including an appearance in the 2014 World Cup. Halloran has played club football in three continents.

Benjamin Andrew Warland is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for Brisbane Roar. He made his professional debut in the A-League against Melbourne City on 25 April 2015. On 31 January 2018, it was announced that Warland would leave Adelaide United on a ​1 1⁄2-year deal with Sydney FC.

Christopher Michael Long (born 25 February 1995) is an English professional footballer who most recently played as a forward for A-League club Brisbane Roar. He is a product of the Everton Academy. Long has represented England from U16 to U20 level.Christopher Michael Long (born 25 February 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Crewe Alexandra.

Dean Anthony Bouzanis (born 2 October 1990) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Brisbane Roar. He played junior football in Australia before joining English side Liverpool as a youth player, where he appeared for the Under 18 and reserves sides.
Dimitri Valkanis (Greek: Δημήτρης Βαλκάνης; born 18 October 2005) is a professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for A-League Men club Brisbane Roar, on loan from AEK Athens.

Georgios Vrakas (Greek: Γεώργιος Βρακάς, pronounced ; born 28 April 2001) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for A-League Men club Brisbane Roar. Career Early career Giorgos Vrakas was born on April 28, 2001, in Ioannina and from an early age joined the Academies of AO Ioannina. In 2014, he took the big step and became a member of the PAOK Academy.

Hosine Bility (/hoˈsi.ne biˈli.ti/; born 10 May 2001) is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for Brisbane Roar. Born a Liberian refugee in Guinea, he represents Australia at youth level. Early life Hosine Bility was born on 10 May 2001 in Guinea, West Africa, and raised in Adelaide, South Australia, after moving there with his family at the age of six.

James Robert McGarry (born 9 April 1998) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Australian A-League Men club Brisbane Roar. McGarry was scouted to attend the APFA academy in Christchurch from Dunedin in 2011. McGarry would have professional trials with Chelsea and Sheffield United.

Joel Bruce King (born 30 October 2000) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a left back for Sydney FC. King made his professional debut for Sydney FC in a Round 27 clash against Newcastle Jets, playing the full game in a 2–0 loss at McDonald Jones Stadium. On 9 May 2019, he signed his first professional contract with the club, penning a one-year deal for the 2019–2020 season.
Justin Vidić (born 29 April 2004) is an Australian soccer player who currently plays as a striker for Brisbane Roar in the A-League.

Matthew Dench is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a left-back and defender for the A-League Men club Brisbane Roar FC. Born on 8 December 2003, the 22-year-old left-footed defender wears jersey number 16. He signed a permanent contract with Brisbane Roar for the 2025–26 A-League Men season after a successful trial period.
Michael Ruhs is a 23-year-old Australian professional soccer player who plays as a forward for the A-League Men club Brisbane Roar.

Mihalis "Michael" Valkanis (Greek: Μιχάλης "Μάικλ" Βαλκάνης, pronounced ; born 23 August 1974) is an Australian association football coach and former player who is the current head coach of Brisbane Roar in the A-League. Club career South Melbourne Hellas Valkanis began his career at South Melbourne at age six and rose through the ranks as a talented junior at South Melbourne to the senior team.

Milorad Stajić (Bosnian: ; born 7 February 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for A-League Men side Brisbane Roar. Born in Switzerland, he has represented Bosnia and Herzegovina at youth level. Club career Born in Meiringen, Switzerland, Stajić started playing in the youth team of Swiss giants FC Basel in 2017.
Nathan Amanatidis (Greek: Νάθαν Αμανατίδης, pronounced ; born 23 January 2006) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Brisbane Roar.

Niall Thom is a 19-year-old Australian professional football player who plays as a forward for Brisbane Roar FC in the Isuzu UTE A-League. Born on 10 August 2006, the towering frontman burst into the top-flight scene during the 2025–26 A-League Men season.

Nicholas "Nick" D'Agostino is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a centre-forward for the Isuzu UTE A-League Men club Brisbane Roar, on loan from Norwegian Eliteserien champions Viking FK. D'Agostino joined Melbourne Victory in August 2021. He signed a three-year contract, reuniting him with his former manager Tony Popovic.

Noah Maieroni is a 20-year-old Australian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for the Isuzu UTE A-League club Brisbane Roar FC. Known as a balanced, ball-winning midfielder with strong technical comfort on the ball, he transitioned from the club's youth academy to the first-team squad ahead of his breakout campaign.

Sabit James Ngor (Swahili: ; born 5 January 2001) is a Kenyan professional footballer who plays as a winger for A-League Men club Central Coast Mariners. Career He made his professional debut on 7 December 2021 in a FFA Cup match for Western United against A-League Men side Wellington Phoenix. For the 2023 season, Ngor signed with Ilves in Finnish top-tier Veikkausliiga.

Nam Tae-hee (Hangul: 남태희; Hanja: 南泰熙; born 3 July 1991 in Busan) is a South Korean footballer currently playing for Qatari side Al-Sadd and the South Korea national team. Besides South Korea, he has played in England, France, and Qatar. He is a versatile midfielder and can play as attacking midfielder or central midfielder. He is known for his honed technique, smooth movement, and dribbling.

Tate Russell (born 24 August 1999) is an Indigenous Australian footballer who plays as a right back for Western Sydney Wanderers in the A-League. Russell was part of the 2017-18 Y-League championship winning Western Sydney Wanderers Youth team. He played the full game as they beat Melbourne City Youth 3-1 in the 2018 Y-League Grand Final on 3 February 2018.

Thomas Michael Aldred (born 11 September 1990) is a professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Indian Super League club Mohun Bagan. Born in England, he represented Scotland at youth level. He has also played for Carlisle United in the Football League and made loan appearances for Workington, Stockport County, Inverness Caledonian Thistle in Scotland and Barrow.
Tyrese Jay Francois is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a central or defensive midfielder for A-League Men club Brisbane Roar.

Virgiliu Postolachi (born 17 March 2000) is a Moldovan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 2 club Grenoble and the Moldova national team. Club career A youth academy product of Paris Saint-Germain, Postolachi joined Lille on 18 July 2019. He signed a four-year deal with Les Dogues and was initially assigned to the reserve side of club.

Youstin Salas is a 29-year-old Costa Rican professional footballer who plays as a right-back or defensive midfielder for the A-League Men club Brisbane Roar. He is currently on a season-long loan from the Costa Rican club Sporting San José.
